mo_ta_cong_viec:
Xtech is a dynamic IT software company building next-generation innovative mobile apps with world-class expertise and cutting-edge tech for global markets. We develop and publish products across three core verticals: AI-powered apps, Health & Wellness solutions, and intelligent Utility tools.
With a team of 25-99 professionals, we foster a collaborative, professional environment focused on high-quality projects, continuous learning, and work-life balance.
Join our dynamic team and help us craft flawless experiences that delight millions of users worldwide.
 
Role Overview:
We are looking for a Product Owner (Monetization) (Middle – Senior) to own and grow revenue across our portfolio of ad-supported mobile apps. Our apps run on an IAA-led hybrid model — roughly 70–80% of revenue from in-app advertising (IAA) and 20–30% from in-app purchases / subscriptions (IAP). You will be the owner of our ad monetization logic end-to-end: ad placement and frequency rules, ad-flow and ad-serving scripts, mediation and waterfall / in-app bidding setup, and continuous A/B testing — maximizing eCPM, ARPDAU and LTV while protecting user experience and retention. This is a hands-on, data-driven role working closely with Product, User Acquisition, and Development.
 
Ad Monetization Logic & Optimization (IAA — primary, 70–80% of revenue):
Own the in-app ads logic across the app portfolio: ad placement, triggering rules, frequency capping, and ad-flow / “user journey with ads” for interstitial, rewarded, banner, native and app-open formats — balancing revenue against user experience and retention.
Design, build and maintain ad scripts and ad configurations (e.g., Google Apps Script, ad-request logic, ad-unit-ID mapping in an advanced-eCPM structure), coordinating with Developers on SDK integration and ad-call implementation.
Set up, operate and optimize ad mediation platforms (AdMob Mediation, AppLovin MAX, ironSource / Unity LevelPlay); build and tune Waterfalls and in-app bidding to maximize eCPM and fill.
Run structured A/B tests on waterfalls, placements, formats and frequency to lift eCPM, ARPDAU, show rate and fill / match rate.
Monitor core ad KPIs (eCPM, match / fill rate, show rate, impressions per DAU, ARPDAU, LTV); troubleshoot ad-serving issues, latency and reporting discrepancies; ensure compliance with AdMob and app-store policies.
Hybrid Monetization — IAP & Subscription (20–30% of revenue):
Optimize IAP and subscription performance: pricing, packages and paywall placement, free trials, conversion rate and average transaction value.
Design and run in-app offers / liveops and retention mechanics that lift recurring revenue without cannibalizing ad revenue.
Balance IAA and IAP so total ARPDAU / LTV is maximized across the hybrid model.
Data, Ad Networks & Cross-functional Collaboration:
Track and analyze monetization performance using Firebase, Google Analytics / GA4, BigQuery / SQL and MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer); turn data into prioritized optimization actions.
Manage ad-network relationships (Google AdMob, Meta Audience Network, Unity, AppLovin, ironSource, Mintegral, Pangle): onboard and test networks, apply best practices, test new features, and resolve fill / latency / policy issues.
Partner with Product Owners, UA, Developers and Designers to embed monetization into product flow and analyze App Flow for the best ad placements and IAP positions.
Conduct competitor and market research to identify new revenue streams and benchmark monetization strategy.
yeu_cau:
(*) Knowledge and Experience:
1–3 years in mobile app monetization, with a focus on in-app advertising (IAA) in a hybrid (ads + IAP / subscription) model.
Hands-on experience with ad mediation platforms (AdMob Mediation, AppLovin MAX, ironSource) and waterfall / in-app bidding setup to optimize eCPM.
Solid understanding of ad logic, ad placement and ad formats (interstitial, rewarded, banner, native, app-open) and the revenue-vs-UX trade-off.
Familiarity with analytics tools (Firebase, Google Analytics / GA4) and MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer); data-driven decision making.
Bachelor's or College degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, Mathematics / Economics, or a related field.
(*) Skill on:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable turning data into prioritized optimization actions.
Structured, disciplined approach to A/B testing and attention to detail when tuning waterfalls, placements and frequency.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with Product, UA, Developers and Designers.
Eager to learn, research, and stay current with ad networks, mediation features and market trends.
Patient and proactive when handling challenges and feedback.
